EN-RD-F00-Q01.text: There's a short sentence and a question on the card. Read them, then tap the answer.

EN-RD-F00-Q02.text: Read the word on the card. Then tap the picture that matches it.

EN-RD-F00-Q03.text: There's a question for you on the card. Read it carefully, then tap the answer.

EN-RD-F00-Q04.text: Read the sentence and the question on the card. Then tap your answer.

EN-RD-F00-Q05.text: A short story and a question are on the card. Read them, then tap your answer.

EN-RD-F00-Q06.text: Read the card and find the answer to its question. Then tap it.

EN-RD-F00-Q07.text: Two sentences and a question are on the card. Read them, then choose your answer.

EN-RD-F00-Q08.text: What does the card say? Read the sentence and the question, then tap your answer.

EN-RD-T01-Q01.text: There's a word on the card for you to read. When you've worked it out, tap the picture that goes with it.

EN-RD-T01-Q02.text: Sounding it out can help. Read the word on the card, then find the picture that shows it.

EN-RD-T01-Q03.text: Which of the three pictures matches the word on the card? Read it to yourself, then tap that one.

EN-RD-T01-Q04.text: Take a look at the word on the card. Once you've read it, tap the picture it names.

EN-RD-T01-Q05.text: Here's a word to read. Look at each picture carefully, then tap the one the word is about.

EN-RD-T01-Q06.text: Slowly does it. Read the word, then tap the picture that shows what it means.

EN-RD-T01-Q07.text: One word, three pictures. Read the word, then choose the picture that matches its meaning.

EN-RD-T01-Q08.text: What does the word on the card mean? Read it, think it over, then tap the picture that fits best.

EN-RD-T01-Q09.text: A word is waiting for you on the card. Read it, then find its picture and tap it.

EN-RD-T01-Q10.text: Can you read the word on the card? Once you have, tap the picture that goes with it.

EN-RD-T02-Q01.text: Look at the picture first. Then read the three words and tap the one that names it.

EN-RD-T02-Q02.text: What's in the picture? Read each word carefully and tap the one that matches.

EN-RD-T02-Q03.text: These words look alike, so read them closely. Tap the word that names the picture.

EN-RD-T02-Q04.text: Have a look at the picture. Then read the words and choose the one that goes with it.

EN-RD-T02-Q05.text: Check the picture, then check each word letter by letter. Which one names the picture?

EN-RD-T02-Q06.text: Before you choose, read all three words. Which one matches the picture?

EN-RD-T02-Q07.text: Think about what the picture shows. Then tap the word that matches it.

EN-RD-T02-Q08.text: Letter by letter, check each word. Which one is the right word for the picture?

EN-RD-T02-Q09.text: Look at the picture, then go word hunting. Which word on the screen matches it? Tap it.

EN-RD-T02-Q10.text: Here's a picture with a word to find. Read each word carefully, then tap the one that matches.

EN-RD-T03-Q01.text: There's a sentence on the card for you to read. Do you think it's true? Tap your answer.

EN-RD-T03-Q02.text: Is the sentence on the card true? Read it carefully, then tap the tick or the cross.

EN-RD-T03-Q03.text: Time to be the judge. Read the sentence on the card, then tap the tick if it's true or the cross if it isn't.

EN-RD-T03-Q04.text: Have a think about the sentence on the card as you read it. Is it true? Tap your answer.

EN-RD-T03-Q05.text: Read every word of the sentence. When you're ready, tap the tick if it's true, or the cross if it's not.

EN-RD-T03-Q06.text: Here's a sentence to check. Read it carefully. True or not true? Tap your answer.

EN-RD-T03-Q07.text: What does the sentence say? Read it, have a think, and tap your answer.

EN-RD-T03-Q08.text: Read the sentence on the card slowly. Then tap the tick if you think it's true, or the cross if you don't.

EN-RD-T03-Q09.text: Picture this sentence in your head as you read it. Is it true? Tap your answer.

EN-RD-T03-Q10.text: Imagine the sentence on the card really happening. Could it be true? Tap the tick or the cross.

EN-RD-T04-Q01.text: A word is missing from the sentence on the card. Read it, then pick the word on the screen that fills the gap.

EN-RD-T04-Q02.text: There's a gap in this sentence. Read it all the way through, then tap the word that fits.

EN-RD-T04-Q03.text: Spot the gap as you read. Try each choice in it quietly, then tap the one that makes sense.

EN-RD-T04-Q04.text: Which word completes the sentence? Read it carefully, then choose.

EN-RD-T04-Q05.text: Something is missing from this sentence. Read it, then pick the choice that belongs in the gap.

EN-RD-T04-Q06.text: First, read the whole sentence. Which word on the screen makes it complete?

EN-RD-T04-Q07.text: Here's a sentence with a word left out. Read it, then choose the word that fits best.

EN-RD-T04-Q08.text: Find the gap in the sentence on the card. Which word on the screen fills it? Pick that one.

EN-RD-T04-Q09.text: This sentence has lost a word. Read it, then help it out by choosing the word that fits.

EN-RD-T04-Q10.text: There's a gap to fill in the sentence on the card. Read it, pick a word that fits, and tap it.

EN-RD-T05-Q01.text: There are three words for you to read. Match each one to the picture that shows it.

EN-RD-T05-Q02.text: Every word here has a picture. Read each one, find its match, and pair them all up.

EN-RD-T05-Q03.text: Three words, three pictures. Read carefully and match every word to its picture.

EN-RD-T05-Q04.text: One at a time, read the words. Then pair each word with its picture.

EN-RD-T05-Q05.text: Look for the picture that goes with each word you read. Match all three.

EN-RD-T05-Q06.text: Can you match every word? Read them, then connect each one to its picture.

EN-RD-T05-Q07.text: Take your time. Read each word, then match it to the right picture.

EN-RD-T05-Q08.text: Words first, then pictures. Match each word to the picture it names.

EN-RD-T05-Q09.text: Each word here has a picture partner. Read the words and match them up.

EN-RD-T05-Q10.text: Help each word find its picture. Read all three, then match them up.

EN-RD-T06-Q01.text: Look at the pictures and read the words. Two of them belong together. Tap those two.

EN-RD-T06-Q02.text: Which two go together? Read each word carefully, then tap both of them.

EN-RD-T06-Q03.text: Find the pair. Read all three words, then tap the two that belong together.

EN-RD-T06-Q04.text: Think about what links the words. Which two belong together? Tap them both.

EN-RD-T06-Q05.text: Have a read of the three words. Then tap the two pictures that go together.

EN-RD-T06-Q06.text: Two of these belong together and one doesn't. Read them, then tap the pair.

EN-RD-T06-Q07.text: Which two make a pair? Read each word, look at each picture, then tap them.

EN-RD-T06-Q08.text: Give each word a careful read. Then tap the two pictures that belong together.

EN-RD-T06-Q09.text: Read the words and find the two that are best friends. Tap both of them.

EN-RD-T06-Q10.text: Two of these words belong together. Read them all, then tap the two that go together.

EN-RD-T07-Q01.text: There are three words to read. Two belong together and one doesn't. Tap the odd one out.

EN-RD-T07-Q02.text: What do these words have in common? Read all three, then tap the one that doesn't belong.

EN-RD-T07-Q03.text: Which one is the odd one out? Read each word carefully, then tap it.

EN-RD-T07-Q04.text: No need to rush. Read all three words, then tap the one that doesn't fit.

EN-RD-T07-Q05.text: Spot the odd one. Read the words, then tap the one that doesn't belong with the others.

EN-RD-T07-Q06.text: Three words, and one doesn't belong. Read them and tap the odd one out.

EN-RD-T07-Q07.text: Which word is different from the other two? Read the card, then tap it.

EN-RD-T07-Q08.text: This card has three words and a question. Read them carefully, then tap the word that answers the question.

EN-RD-T07-Q09.text: One of the three words doesn't belong with the others. Read them all. Can you spot it? Tap it.

EN-RD-T07-Q10.text: Odd one out hunt. Read the words on the card, find the one that doesn't fit, and tap it.

EN-RD-T08-Q01.text: Read the word on the card. Then find the word on the screen that rhymes with it.

EN-RD-T08-Q02.text: Say the word on the card in your head after you read it. Which word on the screen rhymes with it?

EN-RD-T08-Q03.text: Read the card and hear the word in your head. Now tap the choice that rhymes.

EN-RD-T08-Q04.text: First read the card. Then read each choice and tap the one that rhymes with it.

EN-RD-T08-Q05.text: Careful reading needed. Read the word, then check each choice. Which one rhymes?

EN-RD-T08-Q06.text: Some of these choices look similar, so think about how they sound. Read the card, then tap the rhyme.

EN-RD-T08-Q07.text: Start with the word on the card, then read the three choices. Which one rhymes with it?

EN-RD-T08-Q08.text: Say each choice quietly after you read the card. Tap the one that rhymes.

EN-RD-T08-Q09.text: Rhyme time. Read the word on the card, then find its rhyming partner and tap it.

EN-RD-T08-Q10.text: Which word on the screen sounds like the card's word at the end? Read carefully, then tap that one.

EN-RD-T09-Q01.text: The word you're looking for is shown in the instruction. Read along the line and tap it when you find it.

EN-RD-T09-Q02.text: Check the word in the instruction first. Then read the line carefully and tap that word.

EN-RD-T09-Q03.text: Some words in this line look very alike. Read the word you need to find, then tap it in the line.

EN-RD-T09-Q04.text: Your target word is in the instruction. Read it, then scan the line word by word and tap it.

EN-RD-T09-Q05.text: Once you've read the word you need to find, look slowly along the line. Tap it when you spot it.

EN-RD-T09-Q06.text: Find the word shown in the instruction. Read the line carefully and tap it.

EN-RD-T09-Q07.text: Word search time. Read the word in the instruction, then hunt for it in the line and tap it.

EN-RD-T09-Q08.text: First read the word you're hunting for. Then read the line from left to right and tap it when you see it.

EN-RD-T09-Q09.text: Ready for a word hunt? Read the word in the instruction, then find it in the line and tap it.

EN-RD-T09-Q10.text: A word is hiding in this line. Read the instruction to see which one, then find it and tap it.

EN-RD-T10-Q01.text: Read the sentences on the card. Then drag the pictures into the same order.

EN-RD-T10-Q02.text: What happens first, next and last? Read carefully to find out, then put the pictures in that order.

EN-RD-T10-Q03.text: Drag the pictures so they match the order of the sentences. Read the card closely first.

EN-RD-T10-Q04.text: The card describes an order of events. Read it, then arrange the pictures to match.

EN-RD-T10-Q05.text: Look out for order words as you read. Then drag the pictures to match.

EN-RD-T10-Q06.text: Keep track of the order as you read the sentences. Then put the pictures in place, from first to last.

EN-RD-T10-Q07.text: Slow and steady. Read the card, then drag each picture to show the order of what happens.

EN-RD-T10-Q08.text: Read the sentences one by one. What comes first? Put the pictures in the order you read.

EN-RD-T10-Q09.text: Read the card and find out what happens. Then line the pictures up in the right order.

EN-RD-T10-Q10.text: There's a little story on the card. Read it, then put the pictures in story order.

EN-RD-T11-Q01.text: There's a sentence and a question on the card. Read them both, then tap the answer that matches what you read.

EN-RD-T11-Q02.text: Read the sentence carefully, then read the question. Look back at the sentence to find your answer.

EN-RD-T11-Q03.text: Read the card closely. Then answer the question by choosing the option that matches the sentence.

EN-RD-T11-Q04.text: Both the sentence and the question matter. Read them on the card, then pick your answer.

EN-RD-T11-Q05.text: Look for the detail the question asks about as you read the sentence. Then tap your answer.

EN-RD-T11-Q06.text: Every word on the card counts here. Read it all, then choose the answer that matches the sentence.

EN-RD-T11-Q07.text: Slowly read the sentence and the question. Then tap the answer that fits what happened.

EN-RD-T11-Q08.text: Which part of the sentence answers the question? Read the card, find it, then choose your answer.

EN-RD-T11-Q09.text: A short sentence and a question are waiting on the card. Read them both, then tap the answer.

EN-RD-T11-Q10.text: First the sentence, then the question. Read them both on the card. Which answer matches? Tap it.

EN-RD-T12-Q01.text: There's a short passage on the card. Read it, then read the question and tap your answer.

EN-RD-T12-Q02.text: Keep the question in mind as you read the passage. Then pick the answer the passage supports.

EN-RD-T12-Q03.text: Before you answer, read the whole passage. Which choice matches what happened?

EN-RD-T12-Q04.text: Take your time reading the passage. Then answer the question at the end.

EN-RD-T12-Q05.text: As you read the passage, look for the reason behind what happens. Then choose your answer.

EN-RD-T12-Q06.text: Which option fits the passage best? Read it closely, then answer the question.

EN-RD-T12-Q07.text: Read the short passage, then the question. Tap the answer that matches what you read.

EN-RD-T12-Q08.text: Notice what each person does as you read the passage. Then answer the question.

EN-RD-T12-Q09.text: There's a little story on the card. Read it right to the end, then pick the answer that makes the most sense.

EN-RD-T12-Q10.text: What happens in the short story on the card? Read it, then read the question and choose the answer that fits.

EN-RD-T13-Q01.text: Animals or vehicles? Read each word on the card, then drag it into the right group.

EN-RD-T13-Q02.text: Read the words one by one and decide where each belongs. Is it food, or is it a toy? Drag it into its group.

EN-RD-T13-Q03.text: Sort these words into two groups, washing and school. Read each one carefully before you drag it.

EN-RD-T13-Q04.text: Does it keep you safe, or is it just for fun? Read each word and drag it to that group.

EN-RD-T13-Q05.text: Is it a kind word or action, or an unkind action? Read each word, then drag it into its group.

EN-RD-T13-Q06.text: Two groups this time: about money and about weather. Read every word and drag it where it belongs.

EN-RD-T13-Q07.text: Gentle or not gentle? Read each word, picture what it means, and drag it to the right group.

EN-RD-T13-Q08.text: Which words name things your body needs, and which are just a want? Read carefully and sort them into the two groups.

EN-RD-T13-Q09.text: Sorting time. Read each word. Is it fun to say, or is it furniture? Drag it into its group.

EN-RD-T13-Q10.text: Read each word on the card. Does it belong in the night sky or on your feet? Drag it to its group.

EN-RD-T14-Q01.text: There are three sentences to read. Put them in the order the story happens.

EN-RD-T14-Q02.text: Read each sentence and work out what happened first. Then drag them into story order.

EN-RD-T14-Q03.text: The story is jumbled. Read all three sentences, then drag them into the right order.

EN-RD-T14-Q04.text: Look for clues about the order as you read the three sentences. Then put the story together.

EN-RD-T14-Q05.text: What happens first, next and last? Read each sentence carefully, then drag them into order.

EN-RD-T14-Q06.text: Think about how one event leads to the next. Read the sentences, then arrange them in story order.

EN-RD-T14-Q07.text: Make the story make sense from start to finish. Read all three sentences, then drag them into place.

EN-RD-T14-Q08.text: These sentences got mixed up. Read them, then put the story back in the right order.

EN-RD-T14-Q09.text: Find the beginning of the story. Read the three sentences, then drag them into order.

EN-RD-T14-Q10.text: What happened first? Read the three sentences, then drag them into story order.

EN-RD-T15-Q01.text: Read the short story on the card and look for clues. Why do you think it happened? Choose the best answer.

EN-RD-T15-Q02.text: What explains what happened in this story? Read it carefully, then pick the answer the clues point to.

EN-RD-T15-Q03.text: Why did things turn out the way they did? Read the story on the card, then choose your answer.

EN-RD-T15-Q04.text: Read between the lines on this one. Read the story, then choose the reason that makes the most sense.

EN-RD-T15-Q05.text: Slowly read the story, then decide which answer best explains what happened.

EN-RD-T15-Q06.text: Use the clues in the story. Why do you think it ended the way it did? Read, then choose your answer.

EN-RD-T15-Q07.text: Think about why the people in this story acted as they did. Read it carefully, then pick the best answer.

EN-RD-T15-Q08.text: Read the story on the card, including the question at the end. Then choose the answer that fits.

EN-RD-T15-Q09.text: Here's a little story to read. Use the clues, then pick the answer that makes the most sense.

EN-RD-T15-Q10.text: Something has happened here. Read the clues on the card, then pick the answer that explains it best.
